The '''Ghorman system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]].
